environment.description: ECS Fargate service (platform 1.4.0) in isolated VPC subnet with NAT gateway egress. S3 bucket has Block Public Access partially configured: BlockPublicPolicy=true, RestrictPublicBuckets=true, but BlockPublicAcls=false and IgnorePublicAcls=false (legacy compatibility). However, the bucket is fronted by a CloudFront distribution with a Response Headers Policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03, 'SecurityHeadersPolicy') that injects Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'none' and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on ALL responses. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution uses an Origin Access Control (OAC) with signing behavior 'Always' and the S3 bucket policy ONLY grants s3:GetObject to the CloudFront service principal (cloudfront.amazonaws.com) with condition on the specific distribution ARN. The task IAM role has s3:PutObject but NOT s3:PutObjectAcl, and the bucket's Block Public ACLs being false is irrelevant because the PutObject calls without ACL parameter default to bucket-owner-full-control. Direct S3 URL access returns 403 - all reads go through CloudFront which strips/overrides Content-Type response headers via the response headers policy configured with custom Content-Type override set to 'application/octet-stream' for the /tenants/* path pattern behavior.

config.cloudfront_response_headers_policy: SecurityHeadersPolicy + custom Content-Type override to application/octet-stream for /tenants/* behavior
config.s3_bucket_policy: Principal: cloudfront.amazonaws.com, Condition: StringEquals aws:SourceArn distribution ARN only
config.vpc_endpoints: S3 gateway endpoint with policy restricting to upload bucket only
